title: Presenting the activity
description: This is the text the committee reads, and the one that will appear in the programme if the activity is selected.
frenchNotice: Write in French: it is the platform's reference language. IFDD handles the translation of selected activities.

title.label: Activity title
title.hint: Short and explicit. It will be used as is in the programme and on printed material.

summary.label: Summary
summary.hint: Two or three sentences. This is what appears on the activity card in the public programme.

objectives.label: Objectives
objectives.hint: What the activity seeks to achieve. The committee assesses relevance to IFDD's priorities.

detailed_presentation.label: Detailed presentation
detailed_presentation.hint: The run of show, the method, the questions addressed. This is the main part of the file. You may structure the text: subheadings, lists, bold — the layout follows the platform's style guide.

expected_outcomes.label: Expected outcomes
expected_outcomes.hint: What remains afterwards: a document, a commitment, a network, a decision.

target_audience.label: Target audiences
target_audience.hint: Add them one at a time: delegations, civil society, researchers, journalists… They will be shown separately on the activity page.
target_audience.duplicate: This audience is already in the list.

warnings.summaryMissing: Without a summary, your activity card will be silent in the public programme.
warnings.expected_outcomesMissing: Expected outcomes weigh in the committee's score: the “impact” criterion is about them.
warnings.target_audienceMissing: Stating the target audiences helps the committee place the activity and build thematic days.
